readout_other: LFP from tail motor cortex and tail EMG; time-frequency coherence (relative coherence area)
direction_notes: Corticomuscular coherence between LFP and EMG increased after TUS in theta, alpha, beta and gamma bands, mainly theta and alpha within 0.4 s; effects varied with intensity and stimulation duration.
safety_notes: Maximum temperature rise was estimated by calculation (not measured) as about 4.8e-3 degC.

exposures.label: TUS of tail motor cortex, 500 kHz, Isppa and SD sweep

timing.protocol_description: 30 trials per condition with a 4 s inter-trial interval; PRF 1 kHz, DC 50%; Isppa varied (0.4-1.1 W/cm2) at fixed SD, and SD varied (0.1-0.3 s) at Isppa 1.1 W/cm2.

flags.reason: Text states nine mice, but also that six were randomly selected as a sham group and nine were used in the TUS group; counts are inconsistent.
Isppa (W cm-2) given with no statement of whether water or in situ; unspecified domain.
Tone-burst duration is only shown symbolically in a figure legend; no number in text.
SD values 0.1-0.3 s; figure 5 caption and one results sentence give SD = 0.4 s for the intensity sweep, inconsistent with the 0.1-0.3 s range.
Sham group 'without TUS'; mechanism not described.
